resource_policy.schedule: Only one measured/profiled process tree at a time; all other task builds and loads stop. Read-only analysis and remote CI may continue.
resource_policy.scope: Two fixed available virtual CPUs shared by application, generator and local database. Physical-host scheduling and hardware power controls are not exposed; do not claim bare-metal isolation.
resource_policy.database_and_generator_resources: Observe separately; application RSS limit does not silently include the PostgreSQL service or generator.
resource_policy.expected_protocol_outcomes: Declared HTTP/gRPC cancellation and deadline probes must match their exact wire outcome and retire resources; report separately from successful ordinary calls.
resource_policy.failure: Correctness, durable-oracle, loaded-identity, generator-lag/capacity, cleanup or interference failures invalidate the sample. Preserve failures; never reinterpret them as zero errors or change a threshold retroactively.

build_policy.native: Cargo --locked --release; repository thin LTO, one codegen unit, unwind; generic target, no host-native ISA
build_policy.managed: Release Native AOT linux-x64; same actual CLI for each paired driver. Protocol/shared/direct-managed fixtures explicitly x86-64-v2. Reused B21/A17 consumers omit IlcInstructionSet; resolved compiler default is not asserted to equal v2.
build_policy.packages: Fresh complete B24 previous closure per product version, including COMMON; A17 separate two-package codec closure. Same immutable driver and independent protocol client before/after.
build_policy.identities: Source/lock/driver/build/consumer/native/package hashes and procfs actual mapped native/executable paths accompany results. AOT linked managed code is identified by executable, not described as a dynamically loaded DLL.

calibration.extension_rule: If all listed rates pass, extend by doubling until the first failed SLO/generator point or the finite one-million-observation bound. State any unbracketed capacity as a measured lower bound.
calibration.refinement_rule: Bisect the highest passing / first failing rate bracket until its width is at most 10% of the passing rate; confirm selected passing point in three fresh 60-second processes. If any confirmation fails, step down within that already observed bracket and reconfirm.
calibration.long_rate_rule: 80% of highest three-process consistently passing before rate, rounded down to an integer (at least 1). Cap at 500 operations/s because long observation accounting is finite. Record if this cap prevents a near-capacity claim.

concurrency.database: 1, 4, 8, 16 layering; mixed capacity/long group uses 16 client slots
concurrency.protocols: 1, 4, 16, 32, 64 layering; capacity/long group uses 64 slots, four HTTP/2 connections, 32 streams/connection
concurrency.codec: 1 and 2 dedicated workers; mixed capacity/long group uses 2. Four workers are a separate oversubscription stress, not an unannounced long-group change.

calibration.generator: DB/protocol max dispatch lag 100ms; codec 50ms. Record planned, actual dispatched, admitted and completed work and generator resources. Saturated generator points do not establish server capacity.
calibration.warmup_and_recovery: Driver-declared warmup and same-live-process low-rate recovery excluded from effective load time. Retain overload and recovery observations.

short_comparison.interleaving: Before, after, direct Rust; reverse order next repetition. Supplementary managed route where semantics permit. Same fixed arrival inputs/constraints at each point.
short_comparison.noise: Unchanged A21 noise_comparison: 2000 seeded independent bootstrap mean differences, 95% interval. Absolute noise band is the maximum process-mean range of baseline calibration repeats, at least 1000ns; relative band 0. Freeze band per scene from before data, do not choose it from optimization results.
short_comparison.tails: A21 nearest-rank rules; p99 unavailable with fewer than100 successful observations. Single long stages do not supply independent-process confidence intervals.
short_comparison.capacity: Report largest consistently passing sampled rate with bracket and generator caveat; same SLO/resources on both versions and direct Rust.

long_groups.name: sqlite
long_groups.mix: 50% durable business cycle / 50% typed 100-row page; WAL/FULL, BUSY/LOCKED observed, zero hidden retry

long_groups.name: http
long_groups.mix: Frozen protocol profile: tiny/JSON/1MiB upload/download/slow-reader/cancel; equal HTTP1.1 TLS and HTTP2 TLS

long_groups.name: grpc
long_groups.mix: Frozen protocol profile: unary/server/client/duplex streams plus expected deadline/cancel; HTTP2 TLS, identity only

long_groups.name: codec
long_groups.mix: Frozen160-action corpus cycle,50% compress/decompress,50% array/owned,50% entropy;256B/4KiB/1MiB/4MiB weights50/25/20/5

long_acceptance: Ten distinct completed segments on the same two CPU IDs, serially; actual first-to-last effective dispatch at least1800s each, valid generator and exact correctness/ownership/durability. Warmup/calibration/recovery/idle excluded. Interrupted or changed-binary stages do not count.
freeze_completion: Before any product implementation edit, bind calibrated long rates, final driver/profile hashes, actual before artifacts and all lower-level fixture settings in a separate immutable frozen-execution.json. This prospective policy alone is not a claim that calibration or final freeze has completed.
